title: Inspector Gabbar
desc: An honest police officer lives with his mother, stepfather and stepbrother. When a criminal, who intends to join politics, lures his stepbrother into the world of crime, he must go against him.

title: Yuddha Kaanda
desc: A corrupt advocate falsely accuses a commoner of murder and sends him to the gallows. Eventually, the commoner's son becomes a lawyer and embarks on a quest for revenge.

title: Snehitharu
desc: A group of four friends set out to rescue a young boy who has been kidnapped. However, soon their incompetence leads them in the wrong direction.

title: Bangalore Days
desc: Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.

title: Dheeraj
desc: A gang of dacoits terrorises innocent people by stealing their belongings and killing them afterwards. In response, DSP Dheeraj is ordered to bring them to justice.
